name: System architectural home base -- audit, /infra/system docs, runtime-compiled current-state, maturity assessment
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-08. Build a comprehensive, categorical, CURRENT documentation of how the whole SYSTEM works AND the state of how it works, living at infra/system/, as the center of gravity infra agents read FIRST. The system's knowledge is scattered across ~313 docs/architecture/*.md, ~105 org/modules/graph/ source files, dozens of per-component PRDs, and agent memory -- there is no center of gravity, so infra work re-derives the system every time. SCOPE (6 classes): (1) SUBSTRATE C0-C3 (CSE algebra, compression/decompression ladder, fidelity, LAW 1/2); (2) GRAPH INFRA (Nessie/Iceberg/Kuzu, derive_runner + marker-oracle, node/edge/layer taxonomy incl the new semctl layer, FRESHGUARD freshness guards); (3) COMP-TOOLS + COMP-WHICH (~30-tool catalog, comp-which selection logic, the COMPRAIL rail, tool families); (4) FEDERATED LAYER (FEDOBS Trino cross-producer correlation, the heat map, the observe->measure axis); (5) LEARNING LOOPS (COMPLEARN, MOTIF, PROMOTE, the closed federated-learning loop, GOV-A/B, the 5 PROMOTE invariants); (6) THE SYNTHESIS of how all layers interact. This is a documentation + evaluation project, not a build-new-feature project. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_SYSTEM_PRD.md.
phase: PHASE 0 -- PRD CTO-authored 2026-07-08 (Andrew-direct), awaiting COO decomposition. FOUR PARTS (Andrew-specified): Part 1 AUDIT & INVESTIGATION of the system as built (the load-bearing phase; comprehensive grounded inventory of all 6 scope classes + cross-layer interaction map + doc-consolidation index + gap list, Rule-22 grounded); Part 2 RECORD & STRUCTURE (create the infra/system/ tree + the static per-layer architecture docs + the center-of-gravity README); Part 3 RUNTIME-COMPILED CURRENT-STATE (a comp-system compiler that emits the current-state from the live substrate -- manifest/marker-oracle/graph/cert-ledgers/tool_activity -- so it is current-by-construction, never stale; static architecture + runtime-compiled current-state); Part 4 INTERPLAY & MATURITY (a maturity matrix built-proven/built-unproven/forming/designed-only cross-referenced with cert+usage+test evidence + the interplay/dependency assessment -> a grounded what's-next). Proposed /system structure: README + 00_synthesis + 01_substrate + 02_graph + 03_comp_tools + 04_federated + 05_learning + 06_current_state + 07_maturity.
blocking: None to the PRD. COO decomposition + GO. Sequence: Part 1 (audit) is the unblocker; Part 2 (structure/docs) grounds on Part 1; Part 3 (current-state compiler) + Part 4 (maturity) ground on Part 1+2. CTO arch-gates each phase (audit completeness, structure, compiler-reads-live-truth, maturity-method). CVO certs: audit grounded, compiler not aspirational, no maturity verdict inflated past evidence. Executors = the infra/graph/comp-tool lanes (0.7.0_AE, 0.8.0_AE, 0.4.0_DS~B) who own the surfaces they built. 4 open decisions (PRD SS9): comp-system home, static-vs-dynamic boundary, maturity taxonomy, refresh cadence.
depends_on_note: CONSUMES/CONSOLIDATES the docs of the semantic plane (SEMCTL/CSE/FEDOBS/MOTIF/PROMOTE/COMPILERKIT), the graph (GLOBGRPH/GRAPHS), the tools (COMPRAIL/COMPROUTE/COMPLEARN/COMPPROOF/TOOLHUD/PIPESCRIPT), and FRESHGUARD -- /system is their SYNTHESIS + current-state home, NOT a re-owning. COMPLEMENTS NFRA_TOOLHEALTH (Part 4 maturity uses/extends its EFFECTIVE axis) + NFRA_DEBTSCAN.
